name: Rocky
author: spirosrap
variant_note: An independently rebuilt v2 movie-inspired interpretation based conceptually on rmolines's earlier v1 Rocky, with a new atlas, nine standard animation states, and 16 look directions.
asset_note: The final runtime spritesheet was independently rebuilt with OpenAI image-generation tooling under the submitter's direction, then assembled, repaired, and visually reviewed with the Codex hatch-pet workflow. It is not byte-identical to the source v1 atlas.
reference_note: The previously installed Rocky by rmolines and Rocky's Project Hail Mary screen appearance were used for conceptual identity cues. No official stills, logos, title treatments, or marketing artwork are included.
license: Non-commercial fan use and repository redistribution only, with attribution to spirosrap and basis credit to rmolines; Project Hail Mary, Rocky, Eridian, and related rights remain with their respective owners.
description: A tactile, movie-inspired five-limbed Eridian engineer with a weathered stone-and-metal shell, nine task animations, and 16 clockwise look directions.
